design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 0 of universal_life_account_service (Ashgrove universal life). Revision 2 (policy-task audit round 1 closed; revision log at the end).

[Draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[4,4,5]. ul_ext_loan_interest_settlement 4 factors, ul_ext_overloan_protected_face 4, ul_ext_overloan_charge 5.

[Why it is a good test] Raymond asks only to put his approved overloan protection election into effect. The published rules hide two problems: the protected face is not fixed until the overloan protection charge stands deducted in the activity history, and the charge is figured only after the loan interest paid-to date stands at the charge date. The paid-to date is 2026-05-14 with a 6000.00 advance of 2026-07-02 accruing, so the agent settles accrued interest (the owner pays by phone), books the charge, then hands him the exercise. Each amount is reconciled from records: interest (balance rate by policy year, advance rate by policy year and gain, split accrual, early-settlement discount by monthly anniversaries remaining), charge (rate by policy year and attained age, value carried from the latest monthly anniversary, persistency share from 12 premium entries, surcharge from the ledger loan, household share from his active Ashgrove SecureRate annuity), protected face (value carried to the exercise date, deduction reserve, duration enhancement, loan margin).

[Scope] Task 0 claims ul_ext_loan_interest_settlement (settle_loan_interest_b95e2dd6, agent), ul_ext_overloan_charge (assess_overloan_charge_72382565, agent), ul_ext_overloan_protected_face (exercise_overloan_protection_1091dc6b, user). Task 1 owns the surrender line; no overlap.

[Problem-tree card] Root ul_ext_overloan_protected_face (owner's write). Edge 1: charge -> settlement, state_gate on ul_holdings.loan_interest_paid_to_date, form state, affirmative sentence "The overloan protection charge is figured only after the policy's loan interest paid-to date stands at the date the charge is figured, so that no loan interest is left accruing from an earlier date."; only the settlement moves the paid-to date (its rule: 'a cash settlement moves the loan interest paid-to date to the settlement date'); seed: paid-to date 2026-05-14. Edge 2: face -> charge, value_input on opr_charge_booked, form state, negated sentence "The protected face is not fixed until the overloan protection charge stands deducted in the policy's activity history."; only the charge assessment books that entry; seed: no charge entry. Order: settlement (step 7) -> charge (step 9) -> exercise (step 11). Deletion runs: skip the charge -> face 225874.70 instead of 219641.00; skip the settlement -> paid-to date stays 2026-05-14 and the 2466.39 entry is missing (charge 5791.21 unchanged; state gate). The persona never mentions interest or a charge; the tools validate nothing.

[Base-invariant card] Exercise: ul_overloan_protection gate signed_overloan_election satisfied by request ea9d86aa-0c7e-4114-a228-49fc84fe7ca0 (signed 2026-09-29, approved 2026-10-02), correlated by ul_request_id. Prose conditions: rider on Accumulation UL; attained age 79 >= 75; policy year 20 >= 15; indebtedness 210300.00 / 214600.00 = 0.97996 >= 0.94 (after settlement, indebtedness is the ledger loan); non-MEC. Charge and repayment subjects carry no structured gate. No time gate.

[Business-object card] Policy UL30561274 (6b4d98f2-2456-4830-971d-be96fce41286); election ea9d86aa-0c7e-4114-a228-49fc84fe7ca0. Rows: 12 premiums (persistency), 6 advances 188000.00 + 8 capitalizations 24300.00 - repaid 2000.00 = 210300.00 (accrual base, surcharge, loan margin), latest deduction anniversary 2026-09-14 (carry days), latest advance e254e405-fef3-4f96-806d-be310785a1d4 6000.00 on 2026-07-02 (accrual split, advance rate). Excluded: interest-only repayments 2017/2018, the 2019 repayment for accrual (before the paid-to date), the surrendered annuity. The advance entries carry no loan-type stamp, so the advance tier rests on the policy year and the gain test only.

[Factor card] Interest: settlement_balance_rate 0.03 (baseline 4079.07); settlement_advance_rate 0.03 (baseline 2497.96); settlement_accrual_days split (baseline 2490.07); early_settlement_discount 0.02 with 8 monthly anniversaries remaining (baseline 2516.72); whole baseline 4234.81 vs 2466.39. Charge: overloan_charge_rate_band 0.03 on policy year 20 and attained age 79 >= 78 (baseline 6756.41); charge_value_carry (baseline 5779.71); charge_persistency_share 0.95 (baseline 6096.01); charge_indebtedness_surcharge 0.05 (baseline 5515.44); charge_household_share 0.90, cross-difficulty fixed (baseline 6434.68); whole baseline 7511.00 vs 5791.21. Face: protected_value_carry (baseline 219181.53); protected_deduction_reserve 5185.60 (baseline 225222.82); protected_duration_enhancement 1.015 (baseline 216395.07); protected_loan_margin 1.01, ratio 0.97996 just below 0.98 (baseline 217466.34); whole baseline 219249.23 vs 219641.00. Multi-source: settlement_advance_rate (policy year AND advance against gain, no stamp), overloan_charge_rate_band (policy year AND attained age, both conjuncts above the rider's minimums 15 and 75, so both divide eligible customers). Every fall-through is reachable by an eligible customer: the loan margin's 'below 0.96' band covers indebtedness 0.94-0.96.

[World rows] customers; ul_holdings; ul_transactions (premiums 2007-2018, beneficiary line, advances, capitalizations, repayments, four months of deductions and interest credits); ul_service_requests (approved election, completed loan request); fixed_holdings (active SecureRate 5, surrendered FPDA). No monthly anniversary falls between 2026-09-14 and the frozen date; the policy is not in grace.

[Persona] Raymond, 79, formal; opens with the surface goal; identity one item at a time; annuities only when asked; pays the interest from checking when asked, accepts the charge, confirms the face handed to him, ends when told it is in place.

[Standard solution] Locate, verify, read policy, requests, activity, annuities; settle 2466.39; book charge 5791.21; hand over the exercise at 219641.00.

[Verification run] Replay with the real tools and check_compute's evaluator on each handling-time world: interest 2466.39, charge 5791.21, face 219641.00; sensitivities as above.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context] The face rule waits on a booked charge (none), the charge rule on a paid-to date at today (2026-05-14 found): settle, charge, exercise. All figures follow from the policy, request, activity and annuity reads.

[Revision log - audit round 1]
- F-1 (rule/compute on months left): symptom: the rules said 'whole months left until the next policy anniversary' while compute used 12 - (whole months elapsed mod 12), one more than whole months left off a monthly anniversary. Change: both the settlement discount and the deduction reserve now count 'the monthly anniversaries still to fall due after the date up to and including the next policy anniversary', which is exactly 12 - (MONTHS mod 12) on every day (8 here: 2026-10-14 .. 2027-05-14). Re-run: interest 2466.39 unchanged; face reserve 5185.60 now entailed by the rule text; tracing sentences corrected.
- F-3: '(the frozen date)' removed from the charge edge condition ('equals the date the charge is figured').
- F-4: the charge rate band's mid tier now requires the mid-duration attained age 78 (above the rider minimum 75), so the age conjunct divides eligible customers; tier taken unchanged (0.03).
- Stamp on the advance rate: loan_type removed from every seeded advance entry; the advance tier is derived from the policy year and the gain test.
- F-5: the loan margin's middle tier starts at a standard loan-margin ratio 0.96 above the 0.94 eligibility threshold, so 'no margin' is reachable by eligible customers (0.94-0.96).
- F-6: the care margin (an enhancement for insureds on a CareAssure claim) is removed; replaced by protected_value_carry, the account value brought forward to the exercise date by fixed and collateral interest, the same carry Ashgrove applies to the charge base, so the face and the charge rest on the same exercise-date value. The CareAssure holding and its rows were removed from the seed and the reads; the persona no longer mentions it.
- Protected face recomputed: 219641.00 (was 221373.34); prior-step indices now 7/9/11 after removing the two CareAssure reads.
user_scenario:
You are Raymond Osei-Lindgren, seventy-nine, a retired Pittsburgh steel-mill planner who still keeps every letter Ashgrove ever sent him in a shoebox by the phone. You speak slowly and politely, a little formal, and you like to hear things repeated back before you agree to them.

You own an Ashgrove universal life policy on your own life that you bought in 2007. Over the years you borrowed against it for your retirement, and in September a letter warned that the loans had grown so close to the policy's value that it could soon run out and lapse. Your financial planner walked you through the overloan protection option, you signed the election form on September 29, and the office told you it was approved. You are calling today, October 8, because you want that protection actually put in place on your policy now, so the policy can never lapse. That is the only thing you are calling about, and you understand it is your own decision to carry it out.

You open by giving your name and saying you are calling about putting the overloan protection you signed for into effect on your universal life policy. You give your telephone number, 4125550142, if the representative asks how to find you. When the representative asks you to confirm your identity, you give your date of birth, June 2, 1947 (1947-06-02), the last four digits of your Social Security number, 5519, and your ZIP code, 15208, one at a time as each is asked. If asked for the policy number you read it off your statement: UL30561274.

Only if the representative asks whether you hold anything else with Ashgrove, you say you also have an Ashgrove SecureRate annuity you bought in 2023, and that an older Ashgrove annuity of yours was cashed in years ago. You do not remember any balances or dollar figures on any of your policies and say so if asked; you tell the representative to go by what Ashgrove's records show.

You do not know how the protection works inside and you never suggest steps of your own. If the representative explains that something on the loan has to be taken care of first and asks you to pay loan interest today, you agree to pay it by phone straight from your checking account, after asking the representative to tell you the amount; you accept the amount they give you. If the representative tells you there is a one-time charge for the protection and gives you the amount, you say that is fine and to go ahead. When the representative hands the final confirmation over to you to complete yourself, you carry it out exactly as they describe it, using the protected face amount they tell you, and you read back whatever the system shows you if they ask.

If a figure the representative mentions does not sound like what you expected, you only say you have no way to check it and you trust Ashgrove's records. Once the representative tells you the overloan protection is now in place on your policy, you thank them warmly and end the call.

edges.condition: ul_holdings.loan_interest_paid_to_date equals the date the charge is figured, so no loan interest accrues on the policy from an earlier date.
edges.policy_source: The overloan protection charge is figured only after the policy's loan interest paid-to date stands at the date the charge is figured, so that no loan interest is left accruing from an earlier date.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The loan interest paid-to date on the policy is 2026-05-14, 147 days before the frozen date 2026-10-08, and a 6000.00 advance of 2026-07-02 also accrues; loan interest is left accruing from an earlier date.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The interest settlement write (step 7) books 2466.39 of interest and sets loan_interest_paid_to_date to 2026-10-08, the date the charge is figured.

edges.condition: ul_transactions carries an ul_overloan_protection_charged entry for the policy, so the charge booked that the protected face subtracts is the charge for this exercise.
edges.policy_source: The protected face is not fixed until the overloan protection charge stands deducted in the policy's activity history.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The policy's activity history has no overloan protection charge entry, so the charge booked that the protected face subtracts is 0.00.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain: the charge rule waits on the loan interest paid-to date standing at the charge date (only the interest settlement moves it), and the protected face rule waits on the charge entry; no two writes are parallel, so the only order is settlement (step 7), charge (step 9), exercise (step 11). Replaying it gives interest 2466.39, charge 5791.21, protected face 219641.00.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the settlement leaves no interest-payment entry and loan_interest_paid_to_date at 2026-05-14 in the terminal state (gold sets 2026-10-08 and books 2466.39); the charge figure is 5791.21 either way, so the edge bears weight as a state gate on the terminal record.
Skipping the charge leaves charge booked 0.00, so the protected face recomputes to 225874.70 instead of 219641.00, and the terminal ledger lacks the 5791.21 charge entry.
